calendar.matters:
ADDED TO UNCONTESTED CALENDAR FOR Osc For Change Of Name
Off Calendar Sep-13-2002 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: Cause assigned to Dept. 218 for hearing on a Name Change. Present: Loretta M. Norris; Clerk: P. Dias; Reporter: Mitch L. Lyon. Petitioner was sworn and examined. Father of the minor not present. Petitioner stated that he resides in Nicaragua and has had no contact with the minor since infancy - 13 years. Court deems minor effectively abandoned by the father. The court orders minor's name changed to Maria Jesus Morales.
